# Differential cases

Each case is a disagreement between markfmt and goldmark v2.0.2 that
`FuzzDifferential` found (design 11.5). The section of a case gives its
verdict and its rule: "fixed in markfmt", or "goldmark deviates" with the spec
section. The expected HTML is the output of `cmark --unsafe` 0.31.1.

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 4.6 and 6.6: a declaration starts with `<!` and an ASCII letter

goldmark needs an uppercase letter, as GitHub does (`../dialect.md`).

```````````````````````````````` example
x<!x>

<!doctype html>
.
<p>x<!x></p>
<!doctype html>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 4.6: `meta` is not in the tag list of HTML block kind 6

`<meta>` is an HTML block of kind 7, which cannot interrupt a paragraph.

```````````````````````````````` example
a
<meta>
.
<p>a
<meta></p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 4.6: a closing tag of `pre`, `script` or `style` starts HTML block kind 7

Kind 7 excludes these tag names only for an open tag.

```````````````````````````````` example
</script>

</pre>

</style>
.
</script>
</pre>
</style>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 4.7 and 6.3: an angle destination contains no unescaped `<`

```````````````````````````````` example
[a](<b<c>)

[d]: <e<f>

[d]
.
<p>[a](&lt;b<c>)</p>
<p>[d]: &lt;e<f></p>
<p>[d]</p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 4.3 and 4.7: a setext underline after link reference definitions alone is paragraph text

goldmark gives a thematic break, as commonmark.js does. markfmt follows cmark
(`../dialect.md`).

```````````````````````````````` example
[foo]: /url
---
.
<p>---</p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 5.3: a blank line at the end of a code block in a list item leaves the list tight

goldmark makes the list loose, as commonmark.js does. markfmt follows cmark
(design 2, commonmark.js regression 25).

```````````````````````````````` example
- ```
  a

- b
.
<ul>
<li>
<pre><code>a

</code></pre>
</li>
<li>b</li>
</ul>
````````````````````````````````
